definitions.explanation: The chest area of the body, including the ribcage and the organs it houses. A medical/technical term used in hospitals, examinations, and anatomy; everyday speech prefers {胸|むね}.

examples.japanese: {胸部|きょうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
{胸部|きょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じたら→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧。
examples.english: If you feel chest pain, go to a hospital immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{胸部|きょうぶ}⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I undergo chest imaging examinations every year as part of my health checkup.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧ (chest) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part/section). A clinical-register noun used mostly in medical and anatomical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸部|きょうぶ}⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧ / {胸部|きょうぶ}{X線|エックスせん}: chest X-ray
- {胸部|きょうぶ}{外科|げか}: thoracic surgery
- {胸部|きょうぶ}⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧: chest compression (e.g. CPR)
- {胸部|きょうぶ}{痛|つう}: chest pain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧: chest — the everyday word; also used emotionally (⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ 'heart aches')
- ⟦{腹部|ふくぶ}→腹部：21667_fukubu⟧: abdomen — parallel medical term for the abdominal region
- {胸郭|きょうかく}: thorax (skeletal) — specifically the ribcage structure
